spans.s:
f. (-ला)
1 A branch of feminine action, proceeding from love; or the imitation of a lover's manner, speech, gait, &c. by his mistress, to pass the time in his absence.
2 Play, sport, pastime in general.
3 Amorous or wanton sport.
4 A species of the Daṇḍaka metre.
E.
ली embrace, ला to get or give, aff. क and टाप्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Playful.
m. (-लः)
A species of the Atiśarkarī metre.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Done or written sportively, or in the way of sport or pleasure.
E.
लीला used as a verb, aff. क्त.

f. (-ती)
A wanton or sportful woman.
E.
लीला, and मतुप् aff.

n. (-नं)
A pleasure ground, a garden.
E.
लीला sport, and उद्यान a garden.
